item.btmi.exclamation_mark.tooltip: Hold use to charge, release to smash
item.btmi.exclamation_mark.tooltip2: Hitting a block shatters blocks around it and sends out a shockwave; the longer the charge, the larger the area (capped)
item.btmi.exclamation_mark.tooltip3: Press the %s key: Home Run, launching every enemy in the fan-shaped area ahead
item.btmi.exclamation_mark.lore: Silence is for everyone else. You are here to be heard.
item.btmi.dash.tooltip1: Left click: the staff splits into a blade and its sheath
item.btmi.dash.tooltip2: Right click: fire a light orb, lightning strikes on impact
item.btmi.dash.tooltip3: Sneak + hold attack: charge, then leap forward with a slash
item.btmi.dash.tooltip4: Hits build energy; at 10 stacks press the %s key to unleash Myriad Projection
item.btmi.dash.lore: One stroke splits the long night; every story is written after it.
item.btmi.equal_sign.tooltip1: Left click: a heavy double-bladed cleave, high damage but slow
item.btmi.equal_sign.tooltip2: Press the %s key: Bisect, cleave a fissure across the ground ahead
item.btmi.equal_sign.tooltip3: Held in the off hand with Slash in the main hand, the %s key triggers Strikethrough instead
item.btmi.equal_sign.lore: Only when both sides weigh the same can we talk about fairness.
item.btmi.slash.tooltip1: A long thrusting spear with more reach than a normal one-handed weapon
item.btmi.slash.tooltip2: Press the %s key: Piercing Line, a long thrust ahead
item.btmi.slash.tooltip3: Held in the main hand with Equal Sign in the off hand, the %s key triggers Strikethrough instead
item.btmi.slash.lore: The line you cannot finish is the one it crosses out.
item.btmi.obelisk.tooltip1: Left click: extend the light blade from the cross
item.btmi.obelisk.tooltip2: Sneak + right click: summon a floating sentinel, the weapon turns into Recall Obelisk
item.btmi.obelisk.tooltip3: Main and off hand can both summon one; the two sentinels act independently
item.btmi.obelisk.tooltip4: Press the %s key: ring the death knell, calling down a cross of light and marking the enemies it hits
item.btmi.obelisk.lore: First the bell, then the roll call. Those named need not answer.
item.btmi.obelisk_recall.tooltip1: Left click: the sentinel thrusts forward and rams the target
item.btmi.obelisk_recall.tooltip2: Hold right click: the sentinel keeps firing laser bolts
item.btmi.obelisk_recall.tooltip3: Press the %s key: the sentinel darts forward and detonates, destroying itself
item.btmi.obelisk_recall.tooltip4: Press the %s key: ring the death knell, calling down a cross of light and marking the enemies it hits
item.btmi.obelisk_recall.lore: What returns is not a weapon, but a verdict left unfinished.
item.btmi.colon.tooltip1: Right click: open the six-chamber cylinder, any bullet can be loaded (duplicates allowed)
item.btmi.colon.tooltip2: Left click: fire the bullet in the selected chamber
item.btmi.colon.tooltip3: Hold the %s key: open the bullet selection wheel
item.btmi.colon.tooltip4: Each bullet type behaves differently; see the bullet tooltips
item.btmi.colon.tooltip5: Press the %s key: Fan the Hammer, firing every loaded chamber in quick succession
item.btmi.colon.lore: Six chambers, six statements that allow no reply.
item.btmi.high_explosive_bullet.tooltip: Explodes on impact and can break blocks
item.btmi.incendiary_bullet.tooltip: Ignites the surrounding area and sets targets on fire
item.btmi.paralysis_bullet.tooltip: Leaves the target frozen in place for a few seconds
item.btmi.piercing_bullet.tooltip: Higher damage, passes through a hit target and keeps flying
item.btmi.cryo_bullet.tooltip: Freezes and heavily slows creatures in the area
item.btmi.seeker_bullet.tooltip: Locks onto the nearest target and curves toward it
item.btmi.crimson_fang.tooltip1: Left click: fire, right click: switch firing mode
item.btmi.crimson_fang.tooltip2: Press the %s key: spin once to draw an energy ring, which then pulses outward for damage
item.btmi.crimson_fang.tooltip3: Burst: rapid shots; Laser: instant hitscan beam; Shotgun: short-range lightning fan
item.btmi.crimson_fang.lore: It does not ask you to turn back. It simply bites the road shut.
item.btmi.flame_cape.tooltip1: A cape woven from flowing flames, worn in the chest slot
item.btmi.flame_cape.tooltip2: Any damage you deal gains extra fire damage and sets the target ablaze
item.btmi.flame_cape.tooltip3: Press the %s key to summon butterflies; press the %s key to send them at the target under your crosshair
item.btmi.flame_cape.lore: What rests on your shoulders is not fire, but a swarm of butterflies that refuses to leave.
